description: Remove items' effects (Object > Effects > Clear Effects), or reset opacity, blending and effects on the object, stroke, fill and content (Object > Effects > Clear All Transparency)

on.description: Effects panel targets (default: object, stroke, fill and content)

scope.description: effects: turn off every effect on the chosen targets, keeping opacity and blending; all_transparency: also reset opacity to 100%, Normal blending, no isolate or knockout, on all four targets

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: clear_item_effects
title: Clear Item Effects
